promotions.name: Reduced Agency Fee for New Listings
promotions.rule: Sellers who list a property for sale through Nadeem Real Estate Consultant pay a reduced agency commission instead of the standard rate.
promotions.eligibilityConditions: Applies only to new sale listings signed during the promotional period; not combinable with other fee reductions.

promotions.name: First Month Rent Incentive
promotions.rule: Tenants who sign a new 12-month lease on a participating rental property receive a discount on their first month's rent.
promotions.eligibilityConditions: Applies only to new leases of 12 months or longer on properties marked as participating rentals; tenant must complete standard application and screening.

promotions.name: Winter Villa Clearance Offer
promotions.rule: A limited set of luxury villa listings are offered at a reduced list price for buyers who make an offer during the promotional window.
promotions.eligibilityConditions: Applies only to select luxury villa listings designated for this offer; offer must be submitted before the promotion end date; subject to seller acceptance.
